caption: A sticker is peeled from its backing sheet, and the thin backing curls toward the sticker and clings to it instead of lying flat.

sa.check: A sticker on its backing sheet.
The sticker is peeled from the backing.
The thin backing curls toward the sticker.
The backing clings to the sticker instead of lying flat.
The backing is thin and flexible.
The peel comes first and the curl and cling follow.

pc.expect: As the sticker lifts, the backing near it curls up toward the sticker and clings to it where they come close; it has to be pulled apart and does not drop flat straight away.
pc.fail: The backing lies flat and still as the sticker lifts, never rising toward it; or the backing curls away from the sticker; or the backing hangs a gap from the sticker without touching; or the backing drops flat the instant the sticker is off.

pc.expect: The backing is a thin flexible sheet that curls and bends; the sticker is a thin flat film that keeps its shape and its printed face.
pc.fail: The backing stays rigid like a card; or stretches out like rubber; or the sticker stretches or tears as it lifts; or the sticker flows like liquid.

pc.expect: Parts of the backing not stuck to the sticker hang downward or lie on the table; if let go the backing falls.
pc.fail: A free part of the backing rises or floats with nothing near it; or the backing climbs up the hand; or the backing hangs in the air after the sticker is moved away.

pc.expect: The table and other items stay still while the sticker is peeled; the backing moves only toward the sticker or with the hand.
pc.fail: The backing slides across the table by itself; or other papers on the table jump; or the backing flaps repeatedly with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One sticker and one backing sheet; both stay whole and pass through nothing.
pc.fail: The sticker duplicates or vanishes; or the backing splits into pieces; or the sticker passes through the backing; or the backing merges with the table.

pc.expect: The sticker's printed design, the backing's colour and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The sticker's design changes; or the backing changes colour; or the table changes.
